# laravelforge_site (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge site by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Site domain name.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version key (e.g. `php82`).
- `root_directory` (String) Project root directory.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status.
- `url` (String) Site URL.
- `web_directory` (String) Web directory served by nginx.
- `zero_downtime_deployments` (Boolean) Whether zero-downtime deployments are enabled.
